meta.name: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
meta.description: When office worker Akira Yagami gives his life saving a child, he awakens in another world as a weak goblin. But luckily, he’s granted a unique skill that extends his lifespan decades beyond their species limit and allows him to inherit the abilities of fallen goblins. In a realm of powerful races like demons and elves, Akira’s rise to becoming the strongest goblin begins.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
videos.overview: After reincarnating in another world as a mere goblin, Akira's skills from his former life serve him well.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Meeting a Sly Old Fox?
videos.overview: The local border count turns out to defy expectations when Akira goes to parley with him.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Negotiating with Humans?
videos.overview: The goblins are growing more powerful, so Akira seeks to improve public opinion of them amongst humans.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Being an Assassination Target?
videos.overview: Various attempts on Akira's life prompt him to reach a new understanding with Karen and Simon.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Being Disliked by an Adolescent Elf?
videos.overview: When Eunomia gets jealous of her sister Diké giving Akira attention, will anything persuade her otherwise?

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Waging Wardrobe Warfare?
videos.overview: Echigoya is attacked by a human with a goblin vendetta, and Akira responds by using drastic measures.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Making Friends with a Dragon?
videos.overview: The dragon Izyz comes calling, and Akira decides to alter his methods of influencing goblin evolution.

videos.title: So What's Wrong with Wanting to Move Up in the World for My People's Sake?
videos.overview: Akira has a long talk with Simon about how best to advance his position within human society.
